column1: Key propositions
How will you make your customers' life happier?
Know by Monday which matches will fill seats this week. Cut overstaffing on quiet nights; avoid running out of stock on big nights.
Save about 3 hours a week of fixture checking and poster making. All kickoff times already in Singapore time.
Key partners
What are your key partners to get competitive advantage?
football-data.org and TheSportsDB as data providers.
A beverage distributor for venue introductions. Venue associations and F&B business networks in Singapore.
Customer segments
Who are your customers? Describe your target audience in a couple of words.
Primary: independent sports bars and pubs in Singapore with 40 to 150 seats (Clarke Quay, Boat Quay, Holland Village, Robertson Quay).
Secondary: 24-hour cafes and prata shops that screen late matches (Tampines, Jurong, Bedok).
Tertiary: small groups of 2 to 5 outlets under one owner.
Customer relationships
How often will you interact with your customers?
Self-service onboarding for the Starter plan. Named account manager and monthly review call for Pro and Group.
In-app assistant that answers questions from this knowledge base.
Key activities
What are the key steps to move ahead to your customers?
Fetch fixtures and standings daily; refresh badges weekly. Score matches and publish weekly plans.
Generate posters and playbooks; run account reviews.
Key resources
What resources do you need to make your idea work?
Match importance scoring rules (RULE-01 to RULE-04). Data from football-data.org and TheSportsDB.
Venue history: past screenings with actual attendance. Poster templates and brand design system.
Channels
How are you going to reach your customers?
Web dashboard (desktop) for owners and managers; mobile view for floor staff.
Direct sales visits to venues; partnership with a beverage distributor.
Weekly email and WhatsApp-style summary every Monday at 10 am SGT.
Revenue Streams
How much are you planning to earn in a certain period? Compare your costs and revenues.
Monthly subscriptions in three tiers (see DB-01). One-off setup fee of SGD 99 for Group plans.
Optional sponsored poster slots for beverage brands (planned, not live).
Cost Structure
How much are you planning to spend on the product development and marketing for a certain period?
Legal and compliance review for disclaimers, PDPA, and referral rules An ad network or payment processor cut on revenue

Hosting and infrastructure, which stays low on Vercel early on Development and maintenance time Collecting and checking package data, whether manual or scraped Marketing, content creation, and SEO tools
